controls.evidence: Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa) at monad:0x78999cc96d2ba0341588c60ccb0e91c6c33cf371 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x068f22739a5f8a5c84619d7f355b678d00707908 holds 7 enumerated Morpho market IDs. Performance fee 5% of gains, management fee 0%; fee-share accrual is not discretionary minting of underlying USDC. EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero.

review.evidence: Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa) at monad:0x78999cc96d2ba0341588c60ccb0e91c6c33cf371 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x068f22739a5f8a5c84619d7f355b678d00707908 holds 7 enumerated Morpho market IDs. At monad block 110016412 (0x68eb79c), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.638184+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation.
